verdict.rationale: No evidence of a checkpoint/resume mechanism for crashed deep crawls; the evidence pack covers Actors, tasks, webhooks, and CLI/SDK usage but nothing about persisting crawl state (e.g., request queues) and resuming after a crash. While Apify's request queue/dataset persistence could conceivably support this, no documentation or community report confirms a resume-from-checkpoint feature. Missing for 10: documentation of crawl state persistence, an explicit resume/checkpoint API or CLI flag, and any hands-on confirmation that a crashed run can be resumed rather than restarted.
